snippet.title: Gemini X - Announcement Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A World Premiere Announcement Trailer for Gemini X. 
Gemini X is a fast paced sci-fi side-scroller in which you take on rampaging robots as an evolving cyborg warrior. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
